messages:
Elaine (CS): Scheduling Delta Analytics dedicated capacity dry-run TOMORROW 2026-03-05 09:00 PT. Need final checks on quota, autoscale, prefill, and a short load test plan.
Sasha (AE): Confirmed customer will join. Committed: 4x A100, split into two pools (primary + DR). Typical steady 100-130 req/s, report-generation bursts to ~360 req/s for ~90-180s.
Mike (Eng-Infra): Can we get their p95 latency SLO and desired max queue time?
Elaine (CS): They want p95 < 600ms for interactive endpoints, queue p90 < 1s. Will accept short grace for heavy batch reports.
Raj (SRE): Proposed autoscale settings: min=2, max=14, scale_up_rps=140, scale_down_rps=75, up_cooldown=40s, down_cooldown=200s. Add hysteresis to avoid oscillation.
Mike (Eng-Infra): I'll create a k6 scenario that reproduces steady+burst pattern. Example ramp: 5m steady @110rps, spike to 360rps for 2m, cool down 5m. Command snippet:
```
k6 run --vus 120 --duration 14m load/delta-stress.js
# script contains ramp to 360rps and an eval step with deterministic prompts
```
OnboardBot: Dry-run checklist created — [ ] quota assigned, [ ] VPC peering, [ ] certs, [ ] prefill job, [ ] smoke tests, [ ] fallback route, [ ] post-run notes.
Sasha (AE): Note: if we see sustained usage > commit we'll want to flag renewal risk and propose a 20% buffer in the next contract.
Raj (SRE): Prefill plan: run KV prefix prefill for top 50 templates, validate cache hit rate target >=70% before customer VLAN mirror. Alert: cache_hitrate_p90 < 60% -> page oncall.
Mike (Eng-Infra): Fallback route: if queue backlog > 150 for >60s then route to quantized-small model and enable streaming partial outputs. I'll prepare the route and a rollback playbook.
Elaine (CS): Action items:
- Mike: k6 script, prefill job YAML, fallback route + PR
- Raj: alerts, smoke test harness, live log posting
- Sasha: customer comms and renewal-risk note
- Elaine: confirm quotas with finance
DeployBot: Dry-run scheduled for 2026-03-05T09:00:00-07:00. Calendar invite sent.
Raj (SRE): We'll run in staging-dedicated-2 first, then mirror to customer VLAN after prefill verification. I'll stream logs here during the run.
Mike (Eng-Infra): ETA for artifacts: k6 + prefill + autoscale JSON by EOD. Posting PR link when ready.
Sasha (AE): I'll send pre-run checklist to customer. If they ask for a rehearsal, we can slot another dry-run next week.
Elaine (CS): Please add a 10-prompt deterministic eval set (their table-generated reports) to run between phases to check output quality after fallback. Postmortem link will be added after the run.
OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled — 30 minutes before: run prefill verification + smoke tests.
Sasha (AE): :white_check_mark: joining at 09:00 PT. Channel #customer-success-dryruns for breakout.
Elaine (CS): thanks end of thread.
